title: The Hetzner Cloud network stack – history and technical overview
summary: Hetzner published a technical blog post detailing the history and architecture of their cloud network infrastructure, explaining how they built and evolved their network stack to support cloud services.
problem_solved: Provides transparency on how Hetzner built their cloud networking infrastructure from scratch and the technical decisions behind it.
why_valuable: Offers rare technical transparency from a cloud provider about their network architecture decisions and evolution, valuable for infrastructure engineers and DevOps professionals.
